title: Audilogical results of passive middle ear prostheses
summary: The aim of the study is to investigate how patient-related factors influence the audiological outcome following middle ear surgery in which a titanium prosthesis is used to replace small bones. To this end, patients are being recruited for this study at several sites across Germany, and relevant patient data is being collected during and after the operation to determine whether these factors influence hearing ability, which is measured before and after the operation.

interventions.name: As part of their standard surgery, patients will take part in a study-specific data collection process, which will be carried out both during the operation and post-operatively. Additional tone audiometry data will be recorded at the following appointments: pre-operatively, 14 days to 8 weeks after

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Chronic middle ear disease
Capacity to consent
Exclusion criteria:
The patient does not have a chronic middle ear condition
The patient is not capable of giving consent
